Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting pain and reduced motion in the right shoulder.
The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the shoulder complaints recorded at intake. Over seven visits, care
consisted of physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and periodic reassessment. Recovery was somewhat slower than
typically seen with this type of injury, and the course of treatment extended beyond the uusal timeframe. Examination revealed
limited abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff, wihch support the reported injury. Other provocative tests and
neurological screening were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder. Billing
records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. Continued home exercise and follow-up are
recommended, with return to full activity anticipated as strength and mobility improve.

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
